episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A drunken accident takes Sa-gye — the leader of a chart-topping band — from the stage to a university campus, where he meets the girl of his destiny.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Rumors abound as Sa-gye is recruiting for the school band. When a protest erupts demanding his expulsion, a mysterious figure comes to rescue him.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tensions continue to sizzle between SAGYE and Tae-yang as the date of the school festival approaches. Bom plans a team-building trip for the band.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The festival is canceled due to a crowd, and the campus descends into chaos. The TWO SAGYE members search for Tae-yang as fans swarm Bom's house.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Bom and SAGYE grow briefly closer but drift apart when he suddenly disappears. Tae-yang aims to fill the absence, and Bom must make a choice.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The Crown's newest release is a carbon copy of Bom's song. SAGYE prevents her from seeking immediate justice, and the two try to devise a plan.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Tae-yang joins The Crown. TWO SAGYE jumps to the top of the charts with its cover song. In an inevitable turn of events, the two become rivals.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: SAGYE wants to focus on Bom but is bothered about Tae-yang. He visits Director Seo to shake his feelings, but it brings about a new misunderstanding.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The fissure between Tae-yang and TWO SAGYE grows deeper. As Bom and Tae-yang reach the point of no return, SAGYE pitches in with confusing words.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Finally, the truth comes out. SAGYE, Bom and Tae-yang go off on their separate ways, hurting. The pain of breaking up hits like the chill of winter.
